description: This PHP class defines a data model named VacancyDetailedModel for serializing and normalizing detailed vacancy information within the OrangeHRM recruitment system. It constructs the model based on a Vacancy entity and specifies which properties to include in API responses, such as job title details and hiring manager information.

classes.name: VacancyDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed vacancy information accommodating nested objects like job title and hiring manager for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Vacancy entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
